run_train_vjepa: run the main training loop for V-JEPA self-supervised video pretraining with distributed data parallel
build_video_model: build the encoder, predictor, and target encoder models for V-JEPA video representation learning
init_data_loaders: initialize video data loaders with distributed samplers and custom mask collators for training
create_mask_collator: create a mask collator that generates spatial-temporal block masks for video transformer training
make_video_transforms: make video data augmentation transforms with random resize, flip, and random erasing
